title: HubSpot client_secret placeholders and the public client id
summary: A client_secret field holding an angle placeholder, a template or shell reference or a masked or empty value, a prose mention, a request carrying only the client id, and a request signature header name.
rationale: A placeholder, reference, masked or empty value carries no credential. The client id is public configuration beside the secret, and the X-HubSpot-Signature-v3 value is an HMAC output derived from the secret and request details, so it does not contain the secret.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder, reference, masked or empty value, prose mention or public identifier is not a value is a project decision, not a HubSpot statement.

sources.supports: client_secret | String | The app’s client secret.

To generate a client credentials access token, make a URL-form encoded POST request to /oauth/2026-09/token with grant_type=client_credentials. (parameters: grant_type, client_id, client_secret, scope)
The X-HubSpot-Signature-v3 header will be an HMAC SHA-256 hash built using the client secret of your app combined with details of the request.
